name: Shōō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shōō town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing the character 央.
history: Municipal flag of Shōō, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1955.

features.role: Shōō town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing the character 央
